name: Narukami
source:
"That day, I made a promise. I will never let you die."

A dragon god of thunder that protects the Shiro no Miko. He is usually calm and composed, but occasionally is sharp-tongued without any ill will. He is a little lonely. He doesn't have any hobbies, so he's thinking of starting knitting.

In Mashiro's eyes, he is like an older brother.

[Translated from [url=http://mikatuki.sakura.ne.jp/m/contents/character/img/chara_narukami.png]official website[/url]]

One of Mashiro's love interests.
